parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
It is given that $\mu = 0.1$.

Find the distance which the particle has moved up the section $CD$ when its speed is $1 \text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
It is given instead that with a different value of $\mu$ the particle travels $1\text{ m}$ up the track from $C$ before it comes instantaneously to rest.

Find the value of $\mu$ and the speed of the particle at the instant that it passes $C$ for the second time.
